I haven't corrected you a few times you've done this'. This is an explicit REMINDER/REINFORCEMENT of EXISTING authoritative Fenar VISUAL CANON, not a new mechanical benefit or a new attack, and user reports repeated narrator failures. Apply without requiring future player repetition.
Existing owner campaign/continuity/rules-combat-recovery.md Fenar line34 says Double-Claw Rend is a GREATAXE FOR EVERY MECHANICAL PURPOSE including held 7lb heavy two-handed, draw/stow/disarm, damage1d12 slashing, eligible weapon effects, 'shown as ONE double-claw strike, not two or a natural weapon'. Existing tracker trackers/csv/fenar/fenar-features.csv rows65 and70 say visual both claws slash as ONE greataxe attack while raging or NOT raging, and Beast's Claws is separate later attack when activated; artwork visual line32 says greataxe remains a claw-only visual. Ruling is ALREADY AUTHORITATIVE and current user explicitly makes NEVER narrate this as a literal swung greataxe/metal axe/physical axe-head. The melee visual is always Fenar's own forceful PAIR OF CLAWS striking together as a single greataxe-equivalent mechanical action (often called Double-Claw Rend); use such language in every future Fenar attack against enemies, objects, terrain or obstacles even when she is not Raging/Shifted. Equipment remains actual held greataxe for inventory and physical eligibility/disarm logic; merely the visual changes. The distinct Rage Form of the Beast Claw and extra Claw are separate attacks/effects and not doubled by narration. Never create additional attack/damage, mark magic weapon, grant special creature form or consume Rage based only on appearance.

Both physical attacks remain two separate Attack action attacks, each mechanically 2014 greataxe, not two individual claw attack rolls on each attack. Retain all faces, timestamps, DCs, spell slots, NPC rescue, actual horse/cash/property damage, historical chain; no reroll/duplicate new gate damage or extra V choice. Current Day307 ~12:00 at Crownsunder farm trade road, fire contained, oxen/farmhands unharmed, damaged gate and burned wagon/stubble, lingering smoke and safe coach-passable south farm detour +2mi/+1hr remains option; V has not chosen next movement.
